meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: AR(2) characteristic-root moduli across a grid that exercises BOTH branches, plus the two default-argument entry points. `discriminant` and `branch` are recorded so a divergence can be localised to the branch decision rather than the arithmetic.
notes: Math.sqrt is IEEE-754 exact and correctly rounded in both V8 and Rust, so this function should be bit-exact — provided phi and theta are.
The branch test is `disc >= 0`, so disc exactly 0 and disc exactly -0 both take the REAL branch (−0 >= 0 is true).
The default arguments make the default call depend on MISPRICING_PHI, so a phi that is one ULP off shows up here too.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
